decisions.label: Byte order
evidence: The binary header only makes sense read this way.

decisions.label: Samples per trace
evidence: File size divides exactly into traces of this length.

decisions.label: Sample format
evidence: IBM-normalisation test on 40,000 non-zero samples: 0.00% have a zero leading fraction digit (genuine IBM floats: 0%; IEEE floats: typically 5-10%).
This agrees with the declared format.

decisions.label: Data type
evidence: Bytes 221-224 and 225-228 together give a unique grid position for 100.0% of 1200 sampled traces; the first stays constant for runs of traces while the second steps by 1.
The inline number is also stored in byte(s) 223; byte 221 was chosen as the conventional location.
The crossline number is also stored in byte(s) 227; byte 225 was chosen as the conventional location.
Coordinates in bytes 201 and 205 are an exact linear function of (inline, crossline): residual 0.02% of a bin, a perfect regular grid.

decisions.label: Inline number
evidence: Bytes 221-224 and 225-228 together give a unique grid position for 100.0% of 1200 sampled traces; the first stays constant for runs of traces while the second steps by 1.
The inline number is also stored in byte(s) 223; byte 221 was chosen as the conventional location.
Coordinates in bytes 201 and 205 are an exact linear function of (inline, crossline): residual 0.02% of a bin, a perfect regular grid.

decisions.label: Crossline number
evidence: Bytes 221-224 and 225-228 together give a unique grid position for 100.0% of 1200 sampled traces; the first stays constant for runs of traces while the second steps by 1.
The crossline number is also stored in byte(s) 227; byte 225 was chosen as the conventional location.

decisions.label: X coordinate (easting)
evidence: Coordinates in bytes 201 and 205 are an exact linear function of (inline, crossline): residual 0.02% of a bin, a perfect regular grid.
Across all traces, positions deviate from a perfect grid by 0.00404 units RMS; 0 traces are more than half a bin off.

evidence: With scalar -100 the bin/trace spacing is 25.000 m, a standard survey size.

issues.title: Coordinate system needs choosing
issues.detail: Candidates: EPSG:23031 (ED50 / UTM zone 31N), EPSG:32631 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N), EPSG:25831 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 31N), EPSG:23030 (ED50 / UTM zone 30N). The datum is not stated. Candidates on different datums differ by roughly 10-300 m on the ground; confirm the datum with the data supplier before using positions for drilling or permits. Several CRSs fit equally well: EPSG:23031, EPSG:32631, EPSG:25831.
issues.fix: Choose the CRS with --crs EPSG:xxxx (or in the web app). Ask the data supplier if unsure.
issues.explain: Several map projections fit the clues equally well, or the clues contradict the coordinates. Loading with the wrong one shifts the survey by metres to hundreds of kilometres.
